mapper.select: SELECT /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.crisisyngbgscafemng.mapper.BbsCafeWorkListMapper : 카페작업현황*/ count(*) FROM AYE100 WHERE 1=1 AND BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '16' /*게시글유형구분코드*/ AND DEL_YN = 'N' /*삭제여부*/

SELECT /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.crisisyngbgscafemng.mapper.BbsCafeWorkListMapper : 카페작업현황(조회)*/ BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO , BBSCTT_TTL_NM , FRST_REG_DT , FRST_RGTR_ID , C##RG.DEC_B64(WRTR_NM_ENCPT) AS WRTR_NM_ENCPT , TOTAL_COUNT FROM ( SELECT BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /*게시글번호*/ , ( SELECT BB.BBSCTT_TTL_NM FROM AYE100 BB WHERE 1=1 AND BB.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = AA.CAFE_INFO_SN AND BB.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '17' /*게시글유형구분코드*/ ) AS BBSCTT_TTL_NM /*카페명*/ , TO_CHAR(FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS FRST_REG_DT /*최초등록일*/ , FRST_RGTR_ID AS FRST_RGTR_ID /*작성자아이디*/ , WRTR_NM_ENCPT AS WRTR_NM_ENCPT /*작성자명*/ , COUNT(*) OVER() AS TOTAL_COUNT FROM AYE100 AA WHERE 1=1 AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '16' /*게시글유형구분코드*/ ORDER BY BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO DESC OFFSET #{START_IDX} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{ROW_COUNT} ROWS ONLY ) WHERE 1=1
AND BBSCTT_TTL_NM LIKE '%'||#{BBSCTT_TTL_NM}||'%'
AND FRST_RGTR_ID LIKE '%'||#{FRST_RGTR_ID}||'%'
AND C##RG.DEC_B64(WRTR_NM_ENCPT) LIKE '%'||#{WRTR_NM_ENCPT}||'%'
